name: playtime
note: The play time (game/hooks.cpp): the pause menu's Time, kept by the PC's clock rather than by frames played, up to 999:59:59, its hours drawn whole. With the frame rate held to 30 (the game itself at half its speed) it still counts the real seconds (telemetry play_time, 1/300 s; the speed test checks 2x and 4x); set near the most (the live entry playtime=) it stops at 999:59:59; the pause menu shows 999 hours (231 before: the hours were cut to a byte); the first save room's save keeps it, the title (back to it by Back + Start) shows 999 hours on its slot, and the save loads with it.

steps.note: five seconds at 30 frames a second: five seconds of play time, not two and a half

ask.question: What does the Time line at the bottom left of this pause menu read?

choices.other: another time, or no Time line

steps.note: to the first save room and a save there, back into 5.2

ask.question: What play time does the save slot on this load screen show?

choices.other: another time, or no save slot with a time

steps.until: player.active and not loading and not menu
steps.note: loaded: in the save room, its play time as saved
